headline.purpose: The card's single h1 — the status line at Fluent's 28px Title step; the date sits above it as a caption. Segoe UI Variable Display.

section.purpose: List section h2s in --text-2; Overdue variant switches to --critical. h3 drops to 13px.

caption.purpose: Subtitle, strips, undo bars, metadata, hints, errors — 12 to 12.5px, mostly --text-2.

icon.purpose: Segoe Fluent Icons PUA glyphs; 12px base, 13px in icon buttons, 26px empty state. Always aria-hidden with a real label.

shadows.name: card-elevation-light
shadows.purpose: The flyout card's only shadow (light theme). Nothing inside the card casts one.

shadows.name: card-elevation-dark
shadows.purpose: Dark-theme override of the card shadow.

shadows.name: scroll-shadow
shadows.purpose: 10px edge shadows on the scroll region, revealed only when content is hidden (background-attachment local/scroll layering).

motion.name: enter
motion.purpose: Card entrance on show. Guarded by prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: shake
motion.purpose: Refusal feedback when the dismiss gate is not satisfied. Reduced-motion guarded.

motion.name: done-fade
motion.purpose: Completed task text fade under strikethrough. Reduced-motion guarded.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The accent-filled commit action (Add, Connect Google).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #005fb8); color: var(--accent-text, #ffffff); border: none; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-hover, #0067c0); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #005fb8); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet bordered action (Sync now, Undo, Try again); .ds-danger variant is the two-step destructive confirm.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--stroke, rgba(0,0,0,0.09)); color: var(--text, #1b1b1b); border-radius: 4px; padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--subtle-hover, rgba(0,0,0,0.045)); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #005fb8); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-ghost.ds-danger { color: var(--critical, #c42b1c); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--critical, #c42b1c) 45%, transparent); }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: 34px square glyph button (settings, close); aria-pressed tints the glyph accent.
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; color: var(--text-2, #5c5c5c); width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { background: var(--subtle-hover, rgba(0,0,0,0.045)); color: var(--text, #1b1b1b); } .ds-icon-btn[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--subtle-hover, rgba(0,0,0,0.045)); color: var(--accent, #005fb8); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #005fb8); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-fluent { font-family: 'Segoe Fluent Icons', 'Segoe MDL2 Assets'; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1; font-style: normal; }

components.name: Countdown Close
components.description: The dismiss gate: close button whose border is a live conic-gradient countdown ring with a tabular-nums seconds count.
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; color: var(--text-2, #5c5c5c); width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-close-counting { border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid transparent; background: linear-gradient(var(--surface, #f9f9f9), var(--surface, #f9f9f9)) padding-box, conic-gradient(var(--accent, #005fb8) calc(var(--pct) * 1turn), var(--stroke, rgba(0,0,0,0.09)) 0) border-box; color: var(--text, #1b1b1b); } .ds-count { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Fluent text field: control fill, darker bottom edge, accent underline on focus (no ring).
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Add a task for today" />
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; background: var(--control, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--stroke, rgba(0,0,0,0.09)); border-bottom-color: var(--stroke-strong, rgba(0,0,0,0.18)); color: var(--text, #1b1b1b); border-radius: 4px; padding: 7px 10px; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--placeholder, #757575); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent, #005fb8); padding-bottom: 6px; }

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.description: CSS-drawn 40x20 Fluent switch replacing the Chromium checkbox; knob slides 20px and recolors on check.
components.html: <input class="ds-switch" type="checkbox" checked aria-label="Show undated tasks" />
components.css: .ds-switch { appearance: none; -webkit-appearance: none; box-sizing: border-box; width: 40px; height: 20px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--stroke-strong, rgba(0,0,0,0.18)); background: var(--control, #ffffff); position: relative; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; margin: 0; } .ds-switch::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--text-2, #5c5c5c); transition: transform 0.12s ease-out; } .ds-switch:checked { background: var(--accent, #005fb8); border-color: var(--accent, #005fb8); } .ds-switch:checked::before { transform: translateX(20px); background: var(--accent-text, #ffffff); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #005fb8); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Trust Strip
components.description: Sync-truth status row between masthead and lists; .ds-warn variant for errors, glyph flips accent to critical.
components.html: Synced just now
components.css: .ds-strip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--stroke, rgba(0,0,0,0.09)); background: var(--control, #ffffff); font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text, #1b1b1b); } .ds-strip.ds-warn { background: var(--warn-fill, #fdf3d7); border-color: var(--warn-stroke, rgba(157,93,0,0.25)); } .ds-strip.ds-warn .ds-strip-icon { color: var(--critical, #c42b1c); } .ds-strip-icon { color: var(--accent, #005fb8); flex: none; } .ds-fluent { font-family: 'Segoe Fluent Icons', 'Segoe MDL2 Assets'; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1; } .ds-strip-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-strip-action { background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--stroke, rgba(0,0,0,0.09)); color: var(--text, #1b1b1b); border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 12px; font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-strip-action:hover { background: var(--subtle-hover, rgba(0,0,0,0.045)); }

components.name: Task Row
components.description: Flat list row with the 24px circular check whose glyph appears on hover over a 14% accent wash; overdue tag in critical.
components.html: • Renew car registration2 days overdue
components.css: .ds-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 6px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--subtle-hover, rgba(0,0,0,0.045)); } .ds-check { box-sizing: border-box; width: 24px; height: 24px; min-width: 24px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid var(--check-stroke, #767676); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0; } .ds-check:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #005fb8); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #005fb8) 14%, transparent); } .ds-check:hover .ds-check-glyph { color: var(--accent, #005fb8); } .ds-check:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #005fb8); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-check-glyph { font-size: 10px; color: transparent; } .ds-fluent { font-family: 'Segoe Fluent Icons', 'Segoe MDL2 Assets'; line-height: 1; } .ds-task-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-task-text span { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text, #1b1b1b); } .ds-task-text small { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-2, #5c5c5c); } .ds-overdue { color: var(--critical, #c42b1c) !important; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Composer due-date picker; active segment mixes 18% accent into the control fill and goes semibold.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--stroke, rgba(0,0,0,0.09)); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-seg-btn { background: var(--control, #ffffff); border: none; color: var(--text-2, #5c5c5c); padding: 7px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg-btn + .ds-seg-btn { border-left: 1px solid var(--stroke, rgba(0,0,0,0.09)); } .ds-seg-btn:hover { background: var(--control-hover, #f6f6f6); } .ds-seg-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #005fb8); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-seg-btn.ds-active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #005fb8) 18%, var(--control, #ffffff)); color: var(--text, #1b1b1b); font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
TaskDesk is a Windows 11 Notification Center flyout, not an app with a brand. Every surface, stroke, radius, and glyph is chosen so the 520x640 undecorated, transparent, always-on-top window reads as chrome the operating system itself would draw: Fluent mica-adjacent surfaces, one system accent per theme, Segoe UI Variable type, Segoe Fluent Icons. There is no logo, no brand color, no decoration — the identity is fidelity to the host OS.

The card is dense and glanceable: today's truth (overdue, due today, worth checking) leads; input sits pinned at the bottom. Both themes are first-class — the entire token set is defined in :root with a full prefers-color-scheme: dark override block, and no component references a raw color. The signature chrome is the dismiss gate: a close button whose border becomes a conic-gradient countdown ring, and a refusal shake when the gate is not satisfied.
keyCharacteristics: System-native Fluent light/dark, driven entirely by CSS custom properties on :root
One accent per theme (#005FB8 light / #60CDFF dark); critical red is the only other chromatic voice
Segoe UI Variable ramp (Display for headings, Text for body); Segoe Fluent Icons PUA glyphs, no image assets
One elevated card; everything inside is flat, separated by hairline strokes and subtle control fills
Motion is rare, brief, and always prefers-reduced-motion guarded

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Each theme has exactly one accent. Anything interactive that needs color uses --accent; anything wrong uses --critical. No third chromatic voice exists.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: No component states a raw color. Both themes live entirely in the :root custom-property blocks; adding a color means adding it to both blocks.

rules.name: The Two-Face Rule
rules.body: Segoe UI Variable Display for 17px+ headings, Segoe UI Variable Text for everything else. No other family ever appears except the icon font.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: The card floats; nothing inside it does. New surfaces get strokes and control fills, never box-shadows.

dos: Do draw every control the way Windows 11 would: Segoe Fluent Icons glyphs (with aria-hidden + a real label), CSS-drawn Fluent switches, the accent-underline focus idiom on text fields, 4px/8px radii.
Do define any new color in both :root blocks and consume it only via var(); test every surface in light and dark.
Do guard all motion behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference and keep it ≤0.4s.
Do use two-step inline confirms (ghost → danger-ghost "…?") and undo bars instead of dialogs.
Do keep status in strips (role="status"/"alert") between the masthead and the lists.
donts: Don't add a second accent, gradients-as-decoration, or brand color; --accent and --critical are the entire chromatic vocabulary.
Don't put a box-shadow on anything inside the card (The One Shadow Rule).
Don't introduce any font family beyond Segoe UI Variable (Display/Text) and Segoe Fluent Icons, or any raster/SVG image asset — this build ships zero images.
Don't add chrome Windows would not draw: no title bar, no modal dialogs, no custom window buttons beyond the gate-aware close.
Don't restyle the select's popup — its Chromium-drawn dropdown list is a documented, accepted exception (WebView2 residue), not a license for other non-Fluent chrome.
